inspiration: Linear + Stripe (High Information Density, Restrained Chrome, Progressive Disclosure)

headings.usage: Use for primary numbers, section headers, and main dashboard titles. Max size text-5xl.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible body text for data tables, secondary text, and labels.

monospace.usage: Use for coupon codes, API keys, precise numerical data, and data-grid cells.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes with low opacity. No heavy drop shadows in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Extremely subtle ambient shadows. In dark mode, rely on 1px borders and 2px inner-glow highlights (border-t border-zinc-700).
visual_enhancers.radii: Small radii. Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) for cards and buttons. Avoid full pills unless it's a specific badge.
visual_enhancers.ai_elements: Apply a 'Tracing Beam' effect or a subtle #CCFF00 (Neon Lime) inner stroke to AI Copilot prompts and buttons to differentiate them from standard UI.

components.sidebar: Fixed 240px left sidebar. Deep Obsidian background. Active links should have a 2px left border highlight (Cobalt Blue) and a slight surface tint. Use text-sm for density.
components.cards: Flat surfaces with 1px borders. Padding should be generous (p-6) to let typography breathe. Place the most important metric prominently in the top-left quadrant of the card.
components.ai_prompt_bar: Inline floating or docked bar. Must feature a glow or 'tracing beam' border to signify AI capability. Input should have no visible background, using the container's surface.
components.tables: Data-dense. No vertical borders, only subtle 1px horizontal borders between rows. Headers must be text-xs, uppercase, with tight tracking. Use JetBrains Mono for metrics.
components.buttons: Primary: Cobalt Blue background, sharp text. Secondary: Transparent background, 1px border. AI Action: Neon Lime (dark mode) or Black (light mode) with high contrast text.
components.badges: Subtle background tints (10% opacity) with opaque text (e.g., bg-green-500/10 text-green-500). Use for Draft/Scheduled/Active states.

grids.dashboard_bento: 12-column grid. gap-4 or gap-6. Primary metric cards span col-span-3 or col-span-4. Main charts span col-span-8. AI recommendations span col-span-4.

layouts.command_center: h-screen flex overflow-hidden. Left: Sidebar (w-64). Right: Flex-col (Header + Main scrollable content area).
layouts.coupon_designer: Two-column split view (grid-cols-2). Left: Form/Rule builder and AI Prompt. Right: Sticky live preview across formats (Mobile, Email, Print).

motion.progressive_disclosure: Animate height/opacity when revealing deeper data or expanding the AI Copilot bar.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. All secondary text must be at least 4.5:1 against the dark background.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements, sidebar links, forms, buttons, and metric cards MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., 'sidebar-campaigns-link', 'ai-copilot-submit-btn').

media.images: Use for avatar placeholders, workspace logos, and dummy coupon preview visuals.
media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons for a clean, technical SaaS look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a dark-mode first, linear-inspired aesthetic. Avoid generic purple gradients.
Use Shadcn UI for all complex interactive components (Dropdowns, Dialogs, Selects). Customize their classes heavily to match the Flat/1px border aesthetic.
Do not use generic generic transition-all. Be specific with CSS transitions.
Avoid centering main application layout. Keep structural alignment to the left, progressive reading pattern.
For the Coupon Designer preview, ensure it simulates different viewports (mobile, web) accurately using absolute/relative scaling.
Inject data-testid on EVERY interactive element.
CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx. All React components MUST be written in standard .jsx/.js format. Adjust Shadcn and UI elements to omit TypeScript typings.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do NOT use purple-on-white. Stick strictly to the defined Dark Mode #0A0A0A base and Cobalt/Lime accents.
Do NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Never use native <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Layered design: use z-index for dropdowns and sticky headers correctly. Ensure headers do not have transparent backgrounds.
Create depth using 1px borders and distinct surface colors rather than heavy shadows.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and major UI containers for robust testing.
Write all components and files as .js or .jsx, DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) as this is a JS workspace.
